name: stargira-intel-solo
displayName: Stargira Intel Solo: Business News and Gap Finder
description: A personal intelligence system for a sole trader or a small team on one computer. It interviews you about your business, filters the week's news to what matters to you, writes a short 'what this means for you' note on each item, lists the knowledge and capability gaps you need to close with steps for each, and keeps it all in a local searchable store. Runs on your own Claude subscription; no other service.
